description: This Java interface defines a contract for resolving placeholders within a specified source. It includes methods for retrieving the source and resolving placeholder names, optionally returning a constant value if used for validation.

classes.name: PlaceholderResolver
classes.description: A generic interface for resolving placeholders from a source, extending the Placeholder interface.

methods.name: getPlaceholderSource
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the source object used to resolve placeholders.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the placeholder name using the source, returning an Optional<String>. If used solely for validation, it returns 'valid'.
